name: Ponte synthetic PT to EN evaluation v1
author: Codex, in session 01a1829a-60b5-7f91-b903-27adbd1d91a8
source: Newly authored synthetic chat, not real Twitch messages
references: One English reference per Portuguese message, authored with the inputs
policy: Do not edit the translator or glossary in response to these scores. Use a separate development set for changes; any retest on this set must disclose prior exposure.
limits: The dataset author also authored the implementation and has seen the glossary; this is not a blind or independently authored benchmark.
The 50 messages and references were written before their first evaluation run; no scoring feedback was used to revise them.
All examples are PT to EN. This dataset cannot establish EN to PT quality.
Single-reference character overlap cannot establish semantic accuracy or naturalness; independent bilingual human review remains pending.
Synthetic channel emote IDs are placeholders for fragment-preservation tests, not actual CDN image IDs.
